tavily.text:
To install the connectlife-ha package, you need to use pip to install the connectlife package and then generate a skeleton file using the command `python -m connectlife.dump --username <username> --password <password>`. The sources also mention that you can run it locally if you have a Python installation and that a fully restart of Home Assistant is required after creating a device dump. The sources do not provide specific details on the version of Python required or any additional dependencies beyond the connectlife package.
To install the connectlife-ha Python documentation from the GitHub repository, you can either use HACS or download the connectlife directory and place it in your `/custom_components/` directory. After installation, restart Home Assistant. To finalize the setup, open the ConnectLife mobile app, change the app language to English, force close the app, reopen it, accept the Terms & Conditions, and reload the ConnectLife integration in Home Assistant. The app language can be changed back afterward.
The sources do not provide information about the installation requirements for "connectlife-ha" Python package. The provided sources focus on Hyundai vehicle details, including MSRP and financing options, and do not mention anything related to "connectlife-ha" or its installation requirements.
